newsitem.title: USA: Medic Computer System loses half its market value.
newsitem.headline: Medic Computer System loses half its market value.

text.p: Medic Computer System Inc. lost more than half its market value Monday after it said its first-quarter financial results will be below Wall Street expectations and last year's earnings.
Medic's stock plunged $14.50, more than 50 percent, to $13.50 in extremely heavy early trading on the Nasdaq market, where it was the most actively traded issue.
Before the market opened the developer of physician practice management systems said it expected first-quarter earnings per share of between 14 cents and 18 cents.
That was well below analysts' expectations of about 27 cents a share and year-ago earnings of 21 cents a share.
